_comment: Copy this to clients.json and edit it for your own work. The hours step does not run until you do, so nobody gets a timesheet built from someone else's project names. `labels` are matched against the brief's own header ("Morning brief tasks for <X>") and WIN over `patterns`, because a brief is routinely opened in whichever repo is to hand and the folder would then bill it to that project. `patterns` are case-insensitive substrings of a session's working directory; first match wins, so put narrow patterns above wide ones. A session matching nothing is 'unattributed': reported for a person to attribute by hand, never proposed as a timesheet entry. A project absent from this file is silently invisible, not zero, so add one the first time work for it appears.
